brief:
Saraya al-Quds, the military wing of Islamic Jihad, released video footage showing weapons it said were captured following a confrontation with what it described as "collaborationist militias" in the Al-Qarara area north of Khan Younis, Shehab Wire reported. The group posted the footage on social media as documentation of the encounter.

The military wing did not specify the timing of the clash or provide identifying details about the armed group it said it engaged. Officials have not released additional information about the weapons displayed in the video or casualties, if any, from the confrontation in the northern Gaza Strip town.

title: Islamic Jihad releases video of weapons seized after Al-Qarara clash
